summary: Comprehensive testing of Realtouch Invoice new features completed. All backend APIs (18/18 tests passed) and frontend UI features working correctly. Fixed backend syntax error that was preventing server startup.

fixed_issues.issue: Duplicate/corrupted code at end of file (line 1770) causing NameError: 'ent' is not defined
fixed_issues.fix: Removed duplicate shutdown event handler code

backend: GET /api/pdf-templates returns all 5 templates (classic, modern, minimal, emerald, crimson)
POST /api/auth/google endpoint exists and validates credentials
frontend: Landing page loads with correct pricing (Starter £0, Professional £5, Enterprise £49.90)
Login page shows email/password form with Sign In button
Login page shows native Google 'Sign in with Google' button
Login page toggle between Sign In and Sign Up works
Name field appears in signup mode
Email/Password signup flow works and redirects to dashboard
Settings page loads with PDF Template section
All 5 PDF template color options visible (Classic Blue, Modern Dark, Minimal Grey, Emerald Green, Crimson Red)
PDF template selection works with toast notification
Upgrade modal opens from Settings page
Upgrade modal shows Credit Card payment option
Upgrade modal shows Direct Debit (UK BACS) payment option
Upgrade modal shows Google Pay payment option
Upgrade modal shows Professional plan at £5/month
Upgrade modal shows Enterprise plan at £49.90/month
Payment method selection updates upgrade button text

seed_data_creation: Test users created during testing with prefix 'test_', 'uitest_', 'settingstest_', 'pdftest_', 'upgradetest_'
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features tested and working: (1) Pricing updated to Professional £5/month and Enterprise £49.90/month, (2) Custom Google OAuth with native GoogleLogin component, (3) Direct Debit (BACS) payment method in upgrade modal, (4) PDF Template customization with 5 color themes in Settings page, (5) Recurring invoice processing endpoint. Backend had a syntax error that was fixed. Stripe uses test key (sk_test_emergent) and Resend uses placeholder key (re_demo_key).

mocked_apis.Stripe: Uses test key sk_test_emergent - checkout sessions created but not real payments
mocked_apis.Resend: Uses placeholder key re_demo_key - emails not actually sent
mocked_apis.Google OAuth: Requires real Google account - button renders but full OAuth flow cannot be automated
